title: ST-6 SCHEDULER PROVENANCE & INDEPENDENT EXECUTION EVIDENCE
mode: read-only; no order, no credential, no strategy, no backtest, no second scheduled task
authority_order: REAL_RUNTIME > EXECUTION_EVIDENCE > TESTS > SOURCE_CODE > ARCH/RFC > EXTERNAL_SOURCE > ASSUMPTION

host_audit.audited_as: read-only, before anything else; the before-state is kept verbatim

not_done: no ACL, GPO, other channel, size or retention policy was touched
the Security channel was not modified and could not be read
no administrator credential was sought and no restriction was worked around
no second scheduled task was created
gate.coverage_rule: the channel records from the moment it is enabled; no coverage is inferred for any instant before it, and no slot may be promoted retroactively

identifier_semantics.why_not: no record carrying any of them exists in a channel this session can read: the maintenance channel holds only identifiers 800 and 808
identifier_semantics.rule: a record is classified by its channel, task path, instants and instance identifiers; an identifier alone never establishes that a run was scheduled
identifier_semantics.promotion_rule: a meaning becomes usable only through data/st6/rfc047/EVENT_SEMANTICS.json and only when it quotes a record that is really in the store

ledger_integration.carry_forward: a rebuild never weakens a recorded statement; a stronger earlier block is carried forward with the instant it was read

retention.bounded: only records of the monitored task, at most a declared number per read, original fragment kept only up to 8 KiB
retention.preserved_until: the close of the declared period

recomputes: the channel state from the host
the declared slot grid from the period
every classification from the raw evidence
the absence of live orders, credentials and a second task
verification.negative_controls_reading: seventeen manipulations must be rejected and one honest state must be accepted; a case is judged against the baseline of the unmutated artefacts
verification.false_success_definition: a manipulation the verifier accepted, or a claim the artefacts do not support

forbidden_verdicts: VERIFIED because the channel is enabled
VERIFIED because an event exists without a correlation
VERIFIED because the scheduler reports LastTaskResult = 0
VERIFIED because a run log contains the word SCHEDULED
next_gate: the real close of the ST-6 period at 2026-10-22T16:21:20Z; before it, the single command above with an elevated token would let the remaining slots be corroborated as they happen

defects_found_beside_this_rfc.where: scripts/st6_scheduler_verify.py, live tests live_error_exit_status and live_real_execution
defects_found_beside_this_rfc.what: fresh run events are identified by the length of the bounded run log, which is front-truncated at RUN_EVENTS_KEPT (400): one appended event removes one from the front, the length does not change, and the fresh slice is empty
defects_found_beside_this_rfc.effect: the refusal path is reported as misbehaving while it behaves exactly as declared: measured directly at 400/400 with the event REFUSED_INVALID_ARGUMENTS and exit code 1 written
defects_found_beside_this_rfc.repaired_in: a commit of its own, separate from the RFC-047 change set, because the program belongs to the campaign and not to this RFC
defects_found_beside_this_rfc.repair: fresh events are identified by run identity in both live tests, and the launch test waits for an event that declares a scheduled invocation and is not a refusal; no assertion was weakened and one was made stricter
defects_found_beside_this_rfc.reverified: scripts/st6_scheduler_verify.py PASS 5449/5449 checks, 0 mismatches, FALSE_SUCCESS = 0; tests/unit/research/test_st6_scheduler.py 44 passed

no_further_rfc: no RFC-048 and no new strategy campaign is started by this document
